pull_request.title: Add retry to payment webhook handler

pull_request_diff.title: Add retry to payment webhook handler
pull_request_diff.author: octocat
pull_request_diff.body: Adds bounded retry around the webhook POST.

files.patch:
@@ -10,7 +10,14 @@ def handle(event):
-    post(event)
+    for attempt in range(3):
+        try:
+            post(event)
+            break
+        except TimeoutError:
+            continue
